# telnyx_bundle_pricing_billing_bundles (Data Source)

The billing bundles Telnyx offers.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_country_iso` (List of String) Filter by country code.
- `filter_resource` (List of String) Filter by resource.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `bundle_pricing_billing_bundles` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bundle_pricing_billing_bundles))

<a id="nestedatt--bundle_pricing_billing_bundles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bundle_pricing_billing_bundles`

Read-Only:

- `cost_code` (String) Bundle's cost code, this is used to identify the bundle in the billing system.
- `created_at` (String) Date the bundle was created.
- `currency` (String) Bundle's currency code.
- `id` (String) Bundle's ID, this is used to identify the bundle in the API.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Available to all customers or only to specific customers.
- `mrc_price` (Number) Monthly recurring charge price.
- `name` (String) Bundle's name, this is used to identify the bundle in the UI.
- `slug` (String) Slugified version of the bundle's name.
- `specs` (List of String)
